body_es: Cypher es el lenguaje de consulta para Neo4j. La sintaxis es intuitiva: (nodo)-[relación]->(nodo). Para encontrar amigos: MATCH (p:Person)-[:FRIEND]->(friend) WHERE p.name = 'Juan' RETURN friend. Para crear: CREATE (p:Person {name: 'Juan', age: 30}). Para actualizar: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Juan'}) SET p.age = 31. Para eliminar: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'Juan'}) DELETE p. Cypher soporta operaciones complejas: patrones con múltiples saltos, agregaciones, ordering. El potencia real es en traversals: seguir aristas rápidamente a través de los grafos.
body_en: Cypher is the query language for Neo4j. The syntax is intuitive: (node)-[relationship]->(node). To find friends: MATCH (p:Person)-[:FRIEND]->(friend) WHERE p.name = 'John' RETURN friend. To create: CREATE (p:Person {name: 'John', age: 30}). To update: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'John'}) SET p.age = 31. To delete: MATCH (p:Person {name: 'John'}) DELETE p. Cypher supports complex operations: patterns with multiple hops, aggregations, ordering. Real power is in traversals: quickly following edges through graphs.
